gigachat.catalog_note: Strongest first. GigaChat-3-Ultra (15.07.2026) is available only to individuals on Freemium; paid plans receive 402/403/404 and fall through to GigaChat-2-Max. First-generation names GigaChat/GigaChat-Pro/GigaChat-Max are redirected by Sber to the -2 models.

model_fallback.note: 403 and 404: the model is outside this key's plan (catalog_note); the model is retired for this key, the key keeps its other models.

gigachat.schema_free_models_note: Sent without response_format: under a strict schema these models fill JSON indentation with stray words on long answers (seen 2026-09-28 on 10-20 item answers); the schema in the system message plus validation keep the shape.
gigachat.schema_fallback_models_note: 2026-09-29, live on the same documents: under the strict schema GigaChat-3-Ultra writes indented JSON, 2.4 characters per output token; unconstrained it follows the compact one-line instruction: 383 instead of 1884 output tokens on an abstract (6 s instead of 25 s), 10k instead of 26k on a 25-chunk README (162 s instead of 399 s of generation), 1 invalid answer in 28. Such an answer is resent once under the strict schema. Not 2-Max: its constrained answers are the broken ones.

model_routes.note: Used when no model is pinned (LLM_MODEL, LLM_*_MODEL, LLM_MODEL_LADDER). Each route starts with its own model and falls through to every other ladder model when tokens run out (402 or low /balance); a model out of tokens is skipped on all routes. 2026-09-28: GigaChat-2-Max answered every strict-schema review and topic request with invalid JSON, so every route starts with 3-Ultra until 2-Max is verified on live calls.
